title: Export the activity feed
body:
# Export the activity feed

## Problem
Team leads cannot hand the activity feed to people outside the tool, and they cannot take recent changes out in bulk.

## Objectives
- Team leads can take a copy of recent feed activity out of the tool.
- Every export is traceable to the person who requested it.

## Maturity
- marlin: early

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1.** A team lead can request an export of the feed as a spreadsheet file. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC2.** An export can cover any date range the team lead chooses. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC3.** Each export records who requested it and when. *Verified by: manual check.*
